name: Echo
author: Erin Carter
description: A stone well whose echo returns from every wall at once: thin circular wavefronts procession inward at log-spaced stations, but each ring is broken into a shimmering bead-row of arcs by a slowly counter-rotating angular standing wave — the sound scattered off the rough throat, louder from some bearings than others. Rings fill nearly the whole frame, tinted through the palette by depth, fading only at a small off-centre pupil and the extreme corners. The descent and the turning scatter beat against each other into a dense returning chorus, with no visible start or wrap.

params.label: Descent speed
params.effect: Scale-octaves per second the wavefronts sink toward the pupil at the center of the well.

params.label: Ring density
params.effect: Wavefront rings per scale octave — low gives lonely echoes, high a dense procession.

params.label: Scatter
params.effect: Depth of the angular bead modulation — 0 leaves clean circles, 1 shatters each ring into shimmering scattered arcs.

params.label: Halo glow
params.effect: Softness and reach of the glow halo around each ring; 0 leaves crisp bare circles.
